about: The makeyourmindup intro sting, retired for good (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-12: "Nothing before the hook, ever. Remove the sting exception for good."). No cut, wide or tall, series or off day, carries anything before its hook: the first frame of every cut is the hook (house rule HOOK_IS_THE_INTRO). The six clips he saw on the Intro Sting page stay in the library and are named here for the record only; intro.py gives no cut a sting, refuses an approval of this config, and refuses any status but "retired" on it. Its history keeps every word he said about it.

seen.label: Second direction
seen.how: Each clip was taken byte for byte from the page Krish looked at; its sha256 here is the clip he saw. Every clip is kept for the record only and used nowhere.

placement.words: I think it should go at the start of the longer wide videos 100%,
placement.means: Superseded on 2026-11-12 (Ruling, Krish: "Nothing before the hook, ever."). It meant: the 16:9 long cut opened on the sting, then the hook; the 9:16 short cut opened straight on the hook.

colours.picked: Keep it as I saw it
colours.means: Asked whether each series' sting may flash the other series' colours on its way to its own colour and the wordmark, he picked the option to keep it as he saw it. It was the one written exception to the series-colour rule (scripts/pages/brand.py series_look) while the sting opened the wide cut; with the sting retired there is none.

last_decision.words: Nothing before the hook, ever. Remove the sting exception for good.

history.words: it's ok, it's a bit boring and colourless and vanilla - and just what Powerpoint would do in 2008
